items.title: Hong Kong authorities charge seven people after deadly fire
items.description: The seven people charged included directors and inspectors of a consultancy firm involved in the estate's renovation.

items.title: Fisherman attacked after treading on crocodile in northern WA
items.description: Authorities have confirmed the 35-year-old man was fishing in waist deep water at Barred Creek, north of Broome, when he was bitten.

items.title: Twelve dead, nine injured after late-night shooting near Johannesburg
items.description: Police launch a manhunt for more than 10 suspects who launched a late-night attack at the Jumpers informal settlement in the Johannesburg suburb of Cleveland.

items.title: 'National reluctance' to discuss abuse of Indigenous children, says ex-minister
items.description: A review has begun into the family circumstances of Kumanjayi Little Baby leading up to her disappearance and death, which relatives hope will find answers.

items.title: The abortion debate explained
items.description: Since 2023, abortion has been decriminalised nationwide – and polling consistently shows that  most Australians support that. However, now, abortion access is being debated in three different parts of the country. See what's behind the push to revisit abortion laws and what impact the debate may have.

items.title: Illegal peptides are everywhere. Now authorities are cracking down
items.description: The Therapeutic Goods Administration has launched a crackdown on unregulated peptides, saying increased illegal imports were posing a risk to consumers.

items.title: Sea drone saves US helicopter crew downed in waters near Strait of Hormuz
items.description: A look at the US Corsair sea drone used in a first of its kind mission to rescue two helicopter crew shot down near the Strait of Hormuz.

items.title: High Court decision could lead to tens of millions of dollars worth of immigration claims
items.description: There are warnings a High Court ruling allowing a man to sue for false imprisonment over his indefinite immigration detention will lead to more claims running into the tens of millions of dollars.

items.title: Bear attack in Japan car park captured on CCTV as cities record more and more wild encounters
items.description: Bear encounters are rising in Japan, and the problem is not confined to the wilderness.

items.title: Live: Iran attacks US navy base after US retaliates over helicopter downing
items.description: Iran says it struck the US Navy's Fifth Fleet base in Bahrain with drones following a series of US strikes on Iranian cities along the Strait of Hormuz. Follow live.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video
items.description: Federal agencies including DHS, FBI, and ICE investigate $110 million in suspected fraud at Minnesota child care centers following a viral YouTube video[3].

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.title: Elon Musk's Humanoid Robot Vision: China Poised to Lead Production
items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
